storylines.title: Labeler jams make orders late
storylines.pitch: A labeler keeps jamming, orders ship late, and nobody connects the maintenance ticket to the line slowing down.
systems: SAP PM or a CMMS for work orders

incidents.note: Storyline: the jam the demo walks through; vibration climbs for 8 hours first.
Storyline: an earlier jam on the same labeler.

talkTrack.ask: Trend labeler vibration with line speed and state over the last two days.
talkTrack.expect: Vibration climbs for hours, then the line drops to Down while speed goes to zero.

talkTrack.ask: Show the downtime event and the maintenance ticket for that stop.
talkTrack.expect: The ticket opened five minutes after the stop, with the technician and repair time.

talkTrack.ask: Which sales orders shipped late this week?
talkTrack.expect: The late orders were in production on Line 1 when the labeler jammed.

talkTrack.ask: Why were orders late this week, and what should maintenance do about Labeler 202?
talkTrack.expect: An answer that joins the jams, the tickets and the late orders, and points to the worn gripper pads.

storylines.title: The same bearing keeps failing
storylines.pitch: The mix tank agitator fails three times in ten days on the same part (a bearing, or a seal on the syrup plant), and each repair is treated as a one-off.

incidents.note: Storyline: second agitator trip, same bearing.
Storyline: third agitator trip in under a week.

talkTrack.ask: List corrective tickets on Mix Tank 101 with the parts used.
talkTrack.expect: Three tickets in under a week, each replacing the agitator bearing.

talkTrack.ask: Trend agitator vibration and status across the week.
talkTrack.expect: The same vibration rise before every trip: a pattern, not bad luck.

talkTrack.ask: Which assets have repeat failures this month, and what did they cost in parts and downtime?
talkTrack.expect: Mix Tank 101 at the top, with the bearing as the common part.

incidents.note: Storyline: first agitator seal leak on the syrup mix tank.
Storyline: second seal leak on the same agitator.
Storyline: third seal leak in under a week.

talkTrack.ask: List corrective tickets on agitator AG-101 (syrup mix tank 101) with the parts used.
talkTrack.expect: Three tickets in under a week, each replacing the agitator seal.

talkTrack.ask: Trend the agitator's vibration and status with the mix tank's phase across the week.
talkTrack.expect: The same vibration rise before every leak, and the mix tank stops mid-batch each time: a pattern, not bad luck.

talkTrack.ask: Which assets have repeat failures this month, and what did they cost in parts and downtime?
talkTrack.expect: Agitator AG-101 at the top, with the seal as the common part.

storylines.title: A quality hold traced to its cause
storylines.pitch: Lots go on hold for pH, and the analyzer trend shows exactly when the ingredient change began and ended.

excursions.note: Storyline: citric acid supplier switched to a conditionally approved source.

talkTrack.ask: Show this week's quality holds with their lots.
talkTrack.expect: A cluster of pH holds over two days, on both lines.

talkTrack.ask: Trend the pH analyzers on both lines.
talkTrack.expect: pH steps up on both lines at the same time and steps back down two days later: an ingredient, not a line.

talkTrack.ask: What caused the pH holds this week, and which shipments were delayed?
talkTrack.expect: The supplier change window, the held lots and the late shipments.

storylines.title: An uncertified technician closed a safety-critical work order
storylines.pitch: A technician whose certificate had lapsed closed a safety-critical repair, and nobody noticed until the audit.

incidents.note: Storyline: safety-critical filler valve leak on the night crew. The only mechanic on site, Lena Fischer, let her mechanical certificate lapse 10 days ago.

talkTrack.ask: Which safety-critical work orders were closed by technicians whose certificate had expired?
talkTrack.expect: The Filler 201 valve repair three nights ago, closed by Lena Fischer, whose mechanical certificate expired 10 days before.

talkTrack.ask: Show the compliance check for that ticket and the technician's training record.
talkTrack.expect: certified = false with the reason "certificate expired" and its date; the training record's status is Expired.

talkTrack.ask: Trend Filler 201 status and vibration around that repair.
talkTrack.expect: Vibration climbs, the filler faults, and it is back running after the uncertified repair: real work on real equipment.

talkTrack.ask: Open Lena Fischer's ExpiredCertifications and Filler 201's UncertifiedWork.
talkTrack.expect: The same answer from the model: the person, the lapsed certificate and the equipment it touched.

incidents.note: Storyline: safety-critical reactor agitator seal failure on the night crew. The only mechanic on site, Lena Fischer, let her mechanical certificate lapse 10 days ago.

talkTrack.ask: Which safety-critical work orders were closed by technicians whose certificate had expired?
talkTrack.expect: The Reactor 101 agitator seal repair three nights ago, closed by Lena Fischer, whose mechanical certificate had lapsed.

talkTrack.ask: Show the compliance check for that ticket and the technician's training record.
talkTrack.expect: certified = false with the reason "certificate expired" and its date; the training record's status is Expired.

talkTrack.ask: Trend the reactor agitator's status and vibration around that repair.
talkTrack.expect: Vibration climbs, the agitator faults and the reactor stops; it is back running after the uncertified repair.

talkTrack.ask: Open Lena Fischer's ExpiredCertifications and agitator AG-101's UncertifiedWork.
talkTrack.expect: The same answer from the model: the person, the lapsed certificate and the equipment it touched.

talkTrack.expect: RejectCount climbs much faster during some Berry runs: the ones started on the night crew.

talkTrack.ask: Join operatorcompliance to productionruns and compare reject rates.

talkTrack.ask: Which runs were operated without a current certification, and what was their reject rate?

talkTrack.expect: The runs, the operator and the lapsed work-instruction certificate, linked in one model.

storylines.title: Golden batch drift in a reactor
storylines.pitch: Jacket fouling slowly stretches the heat phase, cycle times grow and yield drops until the jacket is cleaned.

preventive.description: Reactor 101 heating jacket descale and clean

drifts.cause: Heating jacket fouling: scale builds up on JK-101

talkTrack.ask: Overlay Temperature for a golden batch from about two weeks ago and a drifted batch from last week, aligned at the start of Heat.
talkTrack.expect: The drifted batch heats more slowly: it trails the setpoint by up to about 12 °C mid-Heat and reaches reaction temperature 20–30 minutes later.

talkTrack.ask: SELECT batch_id, recipe_id, start_utc, deviation_score, yield_percent, golden FROM {prefix}batches ORDER BY deviation_score DESC
talkTrack.expect: The off-golden batches all ran in the last week and a half, with yields about 4 points below the golden 94 %.

talkTrack.ask: Trend HeatRate and BatchDeviation over the whole history.
talkTrack.expect: HeatRate sinks batch after batch while BatchDeviation climbs above 1, then both snap back after the jacket clean.

talkTrack.ask: Find the jacket cleaning ticket (failure_code 'PM-JK101-CLEAN') and list the batches started after it with their deviation_score.
talkTrack.expect: Batches after the clean are golden again (deviation_score at most 1): the cleaning PM ended the drift.

talkTrack.ask: Why did yield drop on R1 last week?
talkTrack.expect: Heat phases stretched as the jacket fouled, yield fell about 4 points, and the jacket clean restored both.

storylines.title: Syrup batches drift and holds follow at the filler
storylines.pitch: Syrup batches take longer and come out low on Brix, and the filler lots made from them go on hold.

drifts.cause: Dissolver steam valve sticking: sugar dissolves slowly and incompletely
Dissolver steam valve sticking: blend runs long to reach Brix

talkTrack.ask: Put the mix tank's Phase and Temperature next to the filler's Brix analyzer for the last ten days.
talkTrack.expect: Dissolve and Blend stretch from about a week ago, and a day or two later the filler's Brix steps down 0.3–0.4 °Bx. The mix tank recovers three days ago; the filler recovers once the last drifted syrup in stock is used up.

talkTrack.ask: Join qualityholds to lots, then lots to batchconsumption on production_order, then to batches: which syrup batches went into each held filler lot?
talkTrack.expect: Every Brix hold traces to syrup batches with low yield_percent and a high deviation_score, made inside the drift window.

talkTrack.ask: Show each syrup batch with its Brix release result (qualitysamples by batch_id, then qualityresults).
talkTrack.expect: The drifted syrup passed its wider release limits (10.4–11.6 °Bx) but tested low: the finished-drink spec caught it at the filler.

talkTrack.ask: Which syrup batches caused last week's holds?
talkTrack.expect: The drifted syrup batches, the filler lots made from them, and the slow dissolve and blend behind them.

storylines.title: Golden batch deviations under GxP
storylines.pitch: Batches drift off the golden profile, each needs a deviation and QA approval, and the audit trail shows who released what.

drifts.cause: Granulation endpoint drift: binder spray nozzle wear

talkTrack.ask: Compare the last batches phase by phase against the golden profile: batchphases.planned_minutes against goldenprofiles.golden_minutes, with each batch's deviation_score.
talkTrack.expect: WetGranulate runs well past its golden 32.5 minutes in last week's batches; their deviation scores exceed 1 and yields are lower.

talkTrack.ask: Trend Phase, AgitatorSpeed and BatchDeviation on the granulator.
talkTrack.expect: The wet granulation step stretches and BatchDeviation rises above 1 for several days, then returns to normal.

talkTrack.ask: Audit trail: list deviations with the batch, the phase, opened and closed times, the QA approver's name, and the batch's released_utc.
talkTrack.expect: Every off-golden batch has a deviation; each was released only after a named QA approver closed it.

talkTrack.ask: Which batches were released with deviations, and who approved them?
talkTrack.expect: The deviated batches, their approvers and release times, and the granulation endpoint drift behind them.

storylines.title: Upstream and downstream speeds out of balance

storylines.title: Root cause of a costly event in minutes
